items.text: fevermint_ 12m “I’m worried my fic sounds like AI.” This is another common sentiment I’m seeing here. There’s really nothing to worry about if you prefer a certain writing style or use certain words that AI commonly uses - I have a few words I love using that are considered AI tells. The thing is, AI uses words/styles/etc in an absurd volume. It’s never a normal, human amount of usage. I promise that if you’re not using AI, your fic most likely does not sound like AI at all. 2

That’s somewhat of a hot take among the AI callout crowd (which I’m a part of), but I don’t see it that way. I do believe it’s important to educate people on AI and to encourage them to do their own research on how to spot AI, too. Just a thought, as I’ve seen a lot of “I feel so stupid” posts recently. 🫶🏻 12 10
